messages:
maria_rodriguez: FYI nightly SAST is spiking failures. Quick check shows KMS decrypt errors in CI after the scheduled rotation. Opening this thread to align on a fast remediation + short runbook.
aj: CI error snippet: `google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt permission denied (403)` from `serviceAccount:scanner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. Any RBAC changes last night?
toshi: I rotated the key at 02:10 UTC per plan and bumped the key version. I didn't reapply the scanner SA binding to the new key resource; missed that step. Sorry.
sec-bot: alert: nightly-sast `redwood-core` failed -> reason `KMS_DECRYPT_FAILED`. Logs: projects/redwood-prod/logs/cloudkms.googleapis.com%2Factivity

devops: Quick mitigation steps:
1) ephemeral grant: add `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` to `scanner@...` for 1 hour.
   e.g.
   ```bash
   gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/keystore/cryptoKeys/main \ 
     --member=serviceAccount:scanner@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com \ 
     --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
   ```
2) create incident ticket tagged `sast-kms` and link policy change (automation from CI if possible).
3) re-run failed CI jobs once binding is in place.
maria_rodriguez: +1. Make sure every policy change is auditable and included in the incident timeline. We should avoid manual permanent grants.
lisa_ng: Add audit export: filter Cloud Audit Logs for `protoPayload.methodName=\"google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt\"` and `resource.labels.crypto_key` so we can correlate rotation vs failures.
samir_k: Proposed short-runbook (to be added to runbooks page):
- Triage: check CI logs for `KMS_DECRYPT_FAILED`. Note `principalEmail` and key resource.
- If principal == `scanner@` -> run ephemeral grant command, tag incident ticket with policy diff, re-run CI.
- If error == `NOT_FOUND` or `INVALID_ARGUMENT` -> likely key/version mismatch -> ask rotation-owner to revert or re-promote previous version.
- Postmortem: export IAM policy snapshot (`gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy`) and attach to ticket; add a test step to rotation checklist.
oncall-1: I'll take first-responder for this window. Please add an alert rule in Datadog/GCP to match logs with `KMS_DECRYPT_FAILED` and route to #eng-oncall + pager.
jenna: Also put a CODEOWNERS rule for `infra/keystore/**` -> `@eng-security` so keystore policy changes require security review.
sec-bot: event: policy-binding-created (actor: toshi) — `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` granted to `scanner@redwood-prod` (TTL 1h).
aj: After TTL expiration verify scanner runs without needing the grant. Also add a periodic rotation simulation that validates CI and RBAC hooks.
lisa_ng: Long-term idea: move scanner to use an envelope key in Secret Manager; scanner has limited access and rotation is handled by secret-manager rotation hooks to reduce manual key policy edits.
devops: I'll wire CI to auto-open `SEC-` issues on decrypt failures and include logs + suggested mitigation command.
maria_rodriguez: Action items and owners:
- Toshi: ephemeral binding now + link policy diff to ticket.
- Devops: CI automation to create `sast-kms` ticket on decrypt errors.
- Lisa: add audit log export and saved filter.
- Jenna: CODEOWNERS PR for `infra/keystore/**` -> `@eng-security`.
- Samir: write the short runbook and retrospective template.
- Oncall-1: monitor / verify and update ticket timeline.

Thanks all — once Samir posts the runbook I'll link it in the alert and close this thread. :white_check_mark:
